title: Make every pear accessible
summary: Review the four screens with a keyboard and document actionable accessibility fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: All four screens can be navigated without a mouse.
Report includes reproduction steps and proposed fixes.

title: Write the first-contribution guide
summary: Help a new contributor go from a useful idea to a reviewable deliverable.
acceptanceCriteria: Explain claims, assignment, submission and manual payment.
Use plain language and include one worked example.

title: Polish the mobile task board
summary: Improve scanning and touch interaction on the smallest screens.
acceptanceCriteria: Controls have visible keyboard focus and clear labels.

title: Document the ratio states
summary: Explain what the comparison means and why source timestamps matter.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover missing, stale and mismatched currencies.
Never describe the ratio as a redemption rate.
